scope: Raise Capacity academic eligibility for the program named in course_prerequisites.json (program_id 1501, Computer Science).

recommendations.APPROVE: All applicable academic requirements are satisfied, section capacity is available, and no required evidence remains unresolved.
recommendations.REJECT: At least one complete applicable eligibility requirement has a confirmed failure. A confirmed failure establishes rejection even when another independent check is unresolved.
recommendations.MANUAL_REVIEW: No confirmed failure establishes rejection, but required evidence is missing, unresolved, conflicting or unverifiable.

requirements.name: Prerequisites and academic standing
requirements.description: The requested course's complete requirement from the validated prerequisite knowledge: prerequisite courses (PRE: completed with a passing grade in an earlier term; PRE_OR_CO: completed earlier or taken in the requested term; CO: taken in the requested term) and academic standing (Student.Completed_Hours against the knowledge file's standing thresholds), combined in one nested AND/OR requirement. Its result is academic_requirement.status; checks.prerequisite and checks.completed_hours show its course and standing conditions.

requirements.name: Section capacity
requirements.description: A seat remains while Current_Capacity is below Total_Capacity + Additional_Capacity (the same rule the database enforces when an approval is saved). Its result is checks.capacity.status.

rules: Program scope takes precedence over every other rule: when program_scope.status is UNSUPPORTED_PROGRAM or MISSING_PROGRAM the recommendation is MANUAL_REVIEW, even when the section is full; no program-specific requirement is applied.
REJECT when academic_requirement.status is NOT_SATISFIED or checks.capacity.status is NOT_SATISFIED.
APPROVE when academic_requirement.status is SATISFIED and checks.capacity.status is SATISFIED.
MANUAL_REVIEW in every other case: academic_requirement.status UNRESOLVED or CONFLICT, or checks.capacity.status UNRESOLVED, with no confirmed failure.
Missing evidence alone never justifies rejection.
The complete requirement decides: one failed alternative of an OR requirement is not a failure when another alternative satisfies the requirement or is unresolved.
grade_policy: Passing grades are those in grade_policy.json (A, B+, B, C+, C, D+, D). F, WF and FA are failing. W, I, a NULL grade in an earlier term and any unrecognised grade are unresolved. A record in the requested term is current enrolment. Records after the requested term are ignored.
